descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S16 「存下的不带单位的体温，在面板和记录上下文里按范围标成 °C（对 3.4 来说是相互矛盾的证据）」 A stored bare temperature is labelled °C by range on the panel and in the note context (conflicting evidence for 3.4)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 A dictated Celsius temperature stays in Celsius: no conversion to Fahrenheit, no change of unit.（UAT TC-23；TFA-94423 AC 5）
  • U7 Nothing that was not dictated appears in the transcript: no words invented on silence or noise, no unit added to a bare value.（UAT 3.4）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Tim's chromium test: Hospital patient with vitals temp '37.4' and weight '72' stored bare

When Open the chart, then Generate Note with mocked model calls

Then The existing test expects the Vitals panel to show 37.4 with no °F and the note's patient context VITALS line to read 'Temp 37.4°C'; the weight gets no unit

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions on the panel text and the generateNote request args. No °F supports U3. But the test asserts that a °C label is added to a bare 37.4, which under 3.4 ('no guessed units on ambiguous values') and Vikram's note prompts (a bare temperature stays bare: note/patient-context.md, note/clinical-quality.md) is an added unit. …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S16 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-23.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

UAT item: TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-23/S16
